fixture: production DesignSettingsEditor with production DesignField, DesignMultilineEditor, and DesignActionButton children

productionOwners.advanced: AdvancedViewModel remains the draft/save owner; no editor-specific status is claimed
productionOwners.fixtureActions: no-op closures used only to render the approved action slots; no persistence or reset behavior is synthesized

platformAdaptations.save: Production Memory and System Prompt save actions remain native navigation toolbar actions; the composite does not move or duplicate ownership
platformAdaptations.focusAndKeyboard: DesignField and DesignMultilineEditor retain native TextField/TextEditor focus, keyboard, scrolling, bindings, limits, counters, and errors
platformAdaptations.dynamicType: Header and optional actions recompose vertically at accessibility sizes; text uses relative project typography
platformAdaptations.rtl: Logical SwiftUI leading/trailing stacks and spacers mirror without offsets
platformAdaptations.reducedMotion: The shell adds no animation; existing native controls retain their reduced-motion handling
platformAdaptations.increasedContrast: The status boundary promotes from lineSoft to ink3 while the field and button primitives keep their existing contrast behavior
platformAdaptations.targets: Optional actions use DesignActionButton and its 44pt semantic minimum target
platformAdaptations.stateSignal: Saved and Unsaved remain explicit text, not color-only signals
